model.architecture: SkinCNN: Conv24/48/64 + BatchNorm/ReLU, two max pools, global average pooling, linear 7-class head
limitations: Research baseline for noncommercial education; no clinical validation, prospective study or external test cohort.
Only 28×28 dermoscopic lesion images; ordinary smartphone/facial photographs are unsupported.
Low resolution discards fine detail and performs poorly for some rare classes; inspect per-class recall.
Lesion IDs are grouped; patient IDs are not released, so patient independence cannot be established.
Known duplicates are corrected upstream; exact hashes and conservative near-duplicate purging are additional safeguards, not a proof of no leakage.
Skin-tone labels are absent; skin-tone subgroup performance and fairness have not been measured.
Source population is drawn from HAM10000 Austria/Australia cohorts, not representative of all users.
Temperature fitted on validation data; scaled model scores are not probabilities of disease or medically validated confidence.
Score/margin rejection thresholds are fixed research heuristics, not clinical safety thresholds or validated OOD detection.
Domain declaration is required; the application cannot verify dermoscopy automatically.
Dataset images carry CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use needs a separate rights review and appropriate permission.

dataset.name: DermaMNIST-C 28
dataset.upload_resize: Nearest pixel-center resize to 28×28; higher resolution upload equivalence not validated

split.method: Published corrected lesion-disjoint partitions; purge whole held-out lesion if an exact/near duplicate of earlier partition is found
split.near_duplicate_rule: 64-bit dHash Hamming distance <=2 AND mean absolute RGB pixel difference <=12; not exhaustive

calibration.method: scalar temperature search 0.5–5.0 in steps of 0.025 minimizing validation NLL
calibration.limitations: The same validation partition selects the checkpoint and fits temperature; no clinical calibration. Test data not used for fitting.

subgroup_limitations: Descriptive image-level results, possibly small and imbalanced groups; fixed seven-label macro metrics assign zero recall to absent classes. No patient IDs or skin-tone labels; no fairness claim.
intended_uses: Education about uncertainty and dataset limitations
prohibited_uses: Reassuring that a lesion is harmless
